units.title: 收雇：三冲不久；收仆以财为用神——财神空则身从心不向、破散则轻疾病重丧亡、绝衰则不得其用、旺而生合世身则手足奉腹心、旺而克冲世则干仆加弱主；未收占臧否止忌三冲财病虽克不嫌、已收占去留亦忌三冲财动克世当去

rule.yi: 凡是占收雇，三冲就不长久。收仆是为了备驱使差遣的人，以财为用神：所以财神空，人虽然跟着我，心却不向着我；财神破、散，轻则疾病、重则丧亡；财神绝、衰，用他不上；财神旺而生合世身的，这是手足来奉养腹心；财神旺而克冲世的，这是干练的仆人欺凌软弱的主人。所以未收时占好坏，只忌三冲、财有病，即使克（世）也不嫌；已经收了占去留，也忌三冲、财动，克世就该让他走。
rule.en: In all divinations about taking on and hiring, the three clashes do not last. Taking on a servant is to have someone to be driven and sent about, and Wealth is the Subject: so with the Wealth spirit Void, the man follows in person but his heart is not toward me; with the Wealth spirit broken or scattered, there is illness at the lightest and death at the worst; with the Wealth spirit extinct or weak, one cannot use him; with the Wealth spirit thriving and generating or combining with the Self, this is hands and feet serving heart and belly; with the Wealth spirit thriving and controlling or clashing with the Self, this is a capable servant bullying a weak master. So when divining before taking him on whether he is good or bad, one fears only the three clashes and a sick Wealth, and even controlling is not objected to; when divining after taking him on whether he will go or stay, one also fears the three clashes and Wealth moving, and when it controls the Self he should go.

zh: 收仆备驱役之使，财为用神，
是以财神空，身虽从而心不向，
财神破散，轻疾病而重丧亡，
财神旺而生合世身者，此手足以奉腹心，
财神旺而克冲世者，此干仆而加弱主。
故未收而占臧否，止忌三冲财病，虽克不嫌；
已收而占去留，亦忌三冲财动，克世当去。
yi: 凡是占收雇，三冲就不长久。
收仆是为了备驱使差遣的人，以财为用神：
所以财神空，人虽然跟着我，心却不向着我；
财神破、散，轻则疾病、重则丧亡；
财神绝、衰，用他不上；
财神旺而生合世身的，这是手足来奉养腹心；
财神旺而克冲世的，这是干练的仆人欺凌软弱的主人。
所以未收时占好坏，只忌三冲、财有病，即使克世也不嫌；
已经收了占去留，也忌三冲、财动，克世就该让他走。
en: In all divinations about taking on and hiring, the three clashes do not last.
Taking on a servant is to have someone to be driven and sent about, and Wealth is the Subject:
so with the Wealth spirit Void, the man follows in person but his heart is not toward me;
with the Wealth spirit broken or scattered, there is illness at the lightest and death at the worst;
with the Wealth spirit extinct or weak, one cannot use him;
with the Wealth spirit thriving and generating or combining with the Self, this is hands and feet serving heart and belly;
with the Wealth spirit thriving and controlling or clashing with the Self, this is a capable servant bullying a weak master.
So when divining before taking him on whether he is good or bad, one fears only the three clashes and a sick Wealth, and even controlling the Self is not objected to;
when divining after taking him on whether he will go or stay, one also fears the three clashes and Wealth moving, and when it controls the Self he should go.

zh: 克世则负己，生世则尽公，
岂能执吉神克世不凶乎？
yi: 没有收的时候，
财疲弱而生世，吉也不吉；
财强健而克世，凶也不凶。
已经收了之后，
如果问忠奸、去留，
克世就是辜负自己，生世就是尽心为主；
怎么能抓着『吉神』克世就说不凶呢？
en: Before he is taken on,
if Wealth is weak and generates the Self, it is auspicious yet not auspicious;
if Wealth is strong and controls the Self, it is ominous yet not ominous.
After he has been taken on,
if one asks about loyalty or treachery, going or staying,
controlling the Self is failing oneself, and generating the Self is serving with all his heart;
how can one hold on to an 'auspicious spirit' controlling the Self and say it is not ominous?

zh: 内详雇工、请人、去恶、防夺、防非、防病诸问
yi: 里面详述雇工、请人、去恶、防夺、防非、防病这几问。
en: Within are treated in detail the questions of hiring labour, engaging a person, getting rid of a bad one, guarding against being robbed of him, against slander, and against illness.

note.yi: 「收雇」是收用仆人、雇工，「驱役之使」是供驱使差遣的人。「财神」是妻财爻。「手足奉腹心」是手足供养腹心，比喻仆人尽心奉主；「干仆加弱主」是能干的仆人欺凌软弱的主人。「臧否」是好坏。「三冲」见 YM.07 注。「虽克不嫌」是还没收的时候财克世也不算坏；「克世当去」是已经收了的，财克世就该让他走。书里自注：未收之时，财弱生世看着吉却不吉，财强克世看着凶却不凶；已收之后问忠奸去留，克世就是辜负自己，生世才是尽心——不能拿『吉神』的名义去说克世不凶。章首目录列的是雇工、请人、去恶、防夺、防非、防病六问。与易林补遗用人藏否（EL.131–133）对着看。
note.en: 'Shougu' is taking on servants and hired hands, and 'quyi zhi shi' is those who are driven and sent about. 'The Wealth spirit' is the Wealth line. 'Hands and feet serving heart and belly' means a servant serving his master with all his heart; 'a capable servant bullying a weak master' is just that. 'Zangpi' is good or bad. For the 'three clashes' see the note to YM.07. 'Even controlling is not objected to' means that before he is taken on, Wealth controlling the Self is not counted as bad; 'when it controls the Self he should go' means that once he is taken on, Wealth controlling the Self means he should be let go. The book's own gloss: before he is taken on, weak Wealth generating the Self looks auspicious but is not, and strong Wealth controlling the Self looks ominous but is not; after he is taken on, in asking about loyalty or treachery and going or staying, controlling the Self is failing oneself and generating the Self is serving with all his heart, and one cannot use the name of an 'auspicious spirit' to say that controlling the Self is not ominous. The index at the head of the chapter lists six questions: hiring labour, engaging a person, getting rid of a bad one, guarding against being robbed of him, against slander, and against illness. Read against the Yilin Buyi on employing people and whether they hide (EL.131-133).

units.title: 收雇·察性情：专于用象——金刚火强水智木仁土信；青龙能文朱雀能言白虎暴戾元武奸勾陈迟钝螣蛇浮；八宫辨之诸星配之（用爻独发：乾志高坤性顺震直巽奸坎暗离明艮讷兑佞，角蛟志尾虎性奎狼心星骥德）

rule.yi: 察他的性情，专看用象：金刚、火强、水智、木仁、土信。青龙能文，朱雀能言，白虎暴戾而玄武奸诈，勾陈迟钝而螣蛇浮躁。用八宫来辨别，用诸星来配合。这是用爻独发时来论的：在乾志向高，在坤性顺，震直、巽奸，坎暗、离明，艮讷、兑佞；角宿有蛟龙之志，尾宿有虎性，奎宿有狼心，星宿有骏马的德性。随生克衰旺来说吉凶。
rule.en: To examine his nature, look only at the Subject image: Metal firm, Fire strong, Water wise, Wood kind, Earth faithful. The Azure Dragon is able in letters, the Vermilion Bird is able in speech, the White Tiger is violent and perverse and the Dark Tortoise is treacherous, Hook Earth is slow and dull and the Coiling Snake is flighty. Tell it by the eight palaces and match it with the stars. This is for a Subject line moving alone: in Qian the ambition is high, in Kun the nature is yielding; Zhen is straight, Xun is crafty; Kan is dark, Li is bright; Gen is slow of speech, Dui is flattering. The Horn mansion has the dragon's will, the Tail mansion the tiger's nature, the Legs mansion the wolf's heart, and the Star mansion the virtue of the steed. Good or ill is told by generation, control, strength and weakness.

zh: 金刚、火强、水智、木仁、土信也。
白虎暴戾而元武奸，勾陈迟钝而螣蛇浮也。
yi: 察他的性情，专看用象：
金刚、火强、水智、木仁、土信。
青龙擅长文章，朱雀擅长言辞，
白虎暴戾而玄武奸诈，勾陈迟钝而螣蛇浮躁。
用八宫来辨别，用诸星来配合。
en: To examine his nature, look only at the Subject image:
Metal firm, Fire strong, Water wise, Wood kind, Earth faithful.
The Azure Dragon is able in letters, the Vermilion Bird is able in speech,
the White Tiger is violent and perverse and the Dark Tortoise is treacherous, Hook Earth is slow and dull and the Coiling Snake is flighty.
Tell it by the eight palaces and match it with the stars.

zh: 震直巽奸，坎暗离明，艮讷兑侫也。
角有蛟志，尾有虎性，奎有狼心，星有骥德也。
yi: 这是用爻独发时来论的：
在乾志向高，在坤性顺，
震直、巽奸，坎暗、离明，艮讷、兑佞；
角宿有蛟龙之志，尾宿有虎性，奎宿有狼心，星宿有骏马的德性。
随生克衰旺来说吉凶。
en: This is for a Subject line moving alone:
in Qian the ambition is high, in Kun the nature is yielding;
Zhen is straight, Xun is crafty; Kan is dark, Li is bright; Gen is slow of speech, Dui is flattering.
The Horn mansion has the dragon's will, the Tail mansion the tiger's nature, the Legs mansion the wolf's heart, and the Star mansion the virtue of the steed.
Good or ill is told by generation, control, strength and weakness.

note.yi: 「用象」是用神（这里指财爻或应爻，看所问是仆还是人）的象。「元武」是玄武。「角」「尾」「奎」「星」是二十八宿：角木蛟、尾火虎、奎木狼、星日马，这里取它们的禽兽性情（「骥德」是良马的德性）。「艮讷兑佞」是艮主讷（不善言辞）、兑主佞（巧言）。「八宫辨之，诸星配之」是先按八宫、再配神煞二十八宿；书里自注：这是用爻独发时的论法。性情的取象与上一章用人（YM.68）用的是同一套，这里多了二十八宿。
note.en: 'The Subject image' is the image of the Subject (here the Wealth line or the Other line, according to whether it is a servant or an ordinary person who is asked about). 'Yuanwu' is the Dark Tortoise. 'Horn', 'Tail', 'Legs' and 'Star' are four of the twenty-eight mansions: the Horn mansion Wood, the dragon; the Tail mansion Fire, the tiger; the Legs mansion Wood, the wolf; the Star mansion Sun, the horse; here their animal natures are taken ('the virtue of the steed' is the virtue of a good horse). 'Gen is slow of speech, Dui is flattering' is Gen governing slowness of speech and Dui governing glib talk. 'Tell it by the eight palaces and match it with the stars' is first by the eight palaces, then matching the spirit-stars and the twenty-eight mansions; the book's own gloss: this is the method for a Subject line moving alone. The images of nature are of the same set as in the previous chapter on employing people (YM.68), with the twenty-eight mansions added here.

units.title: 收雇·游魂归魂与世间：游魂用空有逃亡之变、归魂用破有回赎之嫌；二父二官事系两头、三刑三破身有四体之灾（三破谓岁月日之破）；世空我疑、间动防阻

rule.yi: 游魂卦而用爻空，就有逃亡的变故；归魂卦而用爻破，就有被回赎（被人赎回去）的嫌疑。卦里有两个父、两个官，事情可能两头牵系；三刑、三破，自身常有四体的灾。世空，是我自己疑惑；间爻动，要防阻隔。三破，说的是岁破、月破、日破。
rule.en: With a Wandering Soul hexagram and the Subject line Void, there is a change of flight and absconding; with a Returning Soul hexagram and the Subject line broken, there is the suspicion of being redeemed and taken back. If the hexagram has two Resource lines and two Pressure lines, the matter may be tied at both ends; with three punishments or three breaks the person often has a calamity of the limbs. The Self Void means I am in doubt; a between line moving means guard against obstruction. The 'three breaks' are the break of the year, of the month and of the day.

zh: 游魂用空者，则有逃亡之变，
归魂用破者，则有回赎之嫌。
二父二官，事或两头之系，
三刑三破，身常四体之灾。
yi: 游魂卦而用爻空，就有逃亡的变故；
归魂卦而用爻破，就有被回赎的嫌疑。
卦里有两个父、两个官，事情可能两头牵系；
三刑、三破，自身常有四体的灾。
世空，是我自己疑惑；间爻动，要防阻隔。
en: With a Wandering Soul hexagram and the Subject line Void, there is a change of flight and absconding;
with a Returning Soul hexagram and the Subject line broken, there is the suspicion of being redeemed and taken back.
If the hexagram has two Resource lines and two Pressure lines, the matter may be tied at both ends;
with three punishments or three breaks the person often has a calamity of the limbs.
The Self Void means I am in doubt; a between line moving means guard against obstruction.

yi: 三破，说的是岁破、月破、日破。
en: The 'three breaks' are the break of the year, of the month and of the day.

note.yi: 「游魂」主迁动、「归魂」主回返：游魂卦而用爻空，这个人容易走掉（逃亡）；归魂卦而用爻破，容易被他家里赎回去。「回赎」是（被他的家人）赎回。「二父二官」是卦里有两个父母、两个官鬼。「两头之系」是事情牵连两头。「三刑」是刑，「三破」书里自注：岁破、月破、日破。「四体之灾」是身体的灾。「间动」是间爻动，主阻隔。这一条是雇工、仆人会不会逃、会不会被赎、会不会牵连的预兆。
note.en: 'Wandering Soul' governs shifting and 'Returning Soul' going back: with a Wandering Soul hexagram and a Void Subject line the man easily slips away (absconds); with a Returning Soul hexagram and a broken Subject line he is easily redeemed and taken back by his family. 'Huishu' is being redeemed (by his family). 'Two Resource and two Pressure lines' is two Resource lines and two Pressure lines in the hexagram. 'Tied at both ends' is the matter involving both sides. 'Three punishments' is punishment, and for the 'three breaks' the book's own gloss is the break of the year, the month and the day. 'A calamity of the limbs' is a bodily calamity. 'A between line moving' is a between line moving, which means obstruction. This entry is the sign of whether a hired hand or servant will flee, be redeemed or be drawn into trouble.

units.title: 雇工：雇倩人工以应为用神——应破绝不能美其终、应空散不能谋其始、三冲无定、克世无良；倩蚕织之妇从财（财不可坏）、雇倩从应（应不可病）；应来克世恐害吾事，合冲变冲不可久留、八纯六冲不可暂用

rule.yi: 雇请人工（雇工），就以应为用神：应破、绝，就不能善终；应空、散，就不能开好头；三冲，没有定准；克世，没有良善。雇请养蚕织布的妇女，妇女按财取：财不可坏；雇请（别的）按应取：应不可有病。应来克世，恐怕妨害我的事；合处逢冲、变出冲，不可久留；八纯卦、六冲卦，连暂时用也不可。
rule.en: In hiring labour, the Other is the Subject: the Other broken or extinct, and it cannot end well; the Other Void or scattered, and it cannot get a good start; the three clashes, and there is nothing settled; controlling the Self, and there is no goodness. In hiring a woman who raises silkworms and weaves, a woman is taken by Wealth, and Wealth must not be damaged; hiring is otherwise by the Other, and the Other must not be sick. If the Other comes to control the Self, I fear it harms my affairs; a combination meeting a clash, or a changed clash, means he must not be kept long; a pure hexagram of eight or a six-clash, he must not be used even briefly.

zh: 应破绝则不能美其终，应空散而不能谋其始，
yi: 雇请人工，就以应为用神：
应破、绝，就不能善终；应空、散，就不能开好头；
三冲，没有定准；克世，没有良善。
en: In hiring labour, the Other is the Subject:
the Other broken or extinct, and it cannot end well; the Other Void or scattered, and it cannot get a good start;
the three clashes, and there is nothing settled; controlling the Self, and there is no goodness.

yi: 雇请养蚕织布的妇女，妇女按财取：
财不可坏；
雇请（别的）按应取，应不可有病。
应来克世，恐怕妨害我的事；
合处逢冲、变出冲，不可久留；
八纯卦、六冲卦，连暂时用也不可。
en: In hiring a woman who raises silkworms and weaves, a woman is taken by Wealth:
Wealth must not be damaged;
hiring is otherwise by the Other, and the Other must not be sick.
If the Other comes to control the Self, I fear it harms my affairs;
a combination meeting a clash, or a changed clash, means he must not be kept long;
a pure hexagram of eight or a six-clash, he must not be used even briefly.

note.yi: 「雇倩」是雇请，「人工」是雇工、工匠。「美其终」是善终，「谋其始」是开好头。「蚕织之妇」是养蚕织布的妇女，她们靠做工得钱，所以取财，不取应。「合冲变冲」是合处逢冲、变出六冲（三冲里的两种，见 YM.07 注）。「八纯」是八纯卦（乾、坤、震、巽、坎、离、艮、兑各自的本宫卦，上下同卦，多是六冲）。「不可暂用」是连暂时用一下也不行。这一条用应当雇工的用神，和上面收仆用财（YM.69）分开：仆人是家里的人，取财；外面雇来的人工，取应。
note.en: 'Guqian' is hiring, and 'rengong' is hired labour and craftsmen. 'Mei qi zhong' is a good end, and 'mou qi shi' is a good beginning. 'Can zhi zhi fu' is a woman who raises silkworms and weaves; they earn money by their work, so Wealth is taken and not the Other. 'Hechong bianchong' is a combination meeting a clash and a changed six-clash (two of the three clashes, see the note to YM.07). 'Ba chun' is the pure hexagrams of the eight (the home hexagram of each of Qian, Kun, Zhen, Xun, Kan, Li, Gen and Dui, with the same trigram above and below, mostly a six-clash). 'Not to be used even briefly' is that even using him for a short time will not do. This entry takes the Other as the Subject for hired labour, to be kept apart from taking on a servant by Wealth (YM.69): a servant is one of the household and is taken by Wealth, while labour hired from outside is taken by the Other.

units.title: 雇工·去来与防夺、防非、防病：欲其去应克世而不去、欲其来应受阻而弗来；人可信矣防被夺——应克世而被争；人可用矣防是非——官动官克而被讼；人可用矣防病——命墓、应坏、鬼动而患病

rule.yi: 想要他走，应克世，他就不走；想要他来，应受阻，他就不来。这个人可以信任了，会不会被人夺走？应克世，就被人争。这个人可以用了，会不会遭受是非？官动、官克，就被告。这个人可以用了，会不会生病？命墓、应坏、鬼动，就患病。
rule.en: If one wants him to go, with the Other controlling the Self he does not go; if one wants him to come, with the Other obstructed he does not come. The man can be trusted: will he not be taken from me? With the Other controlling the Self, he is fought over. The man can be used: will he not meet with slander and trouble? With Pressure moving and Pressure controlling, he is sued. The man can be used: will he not fall ill? With the life line in the tomb, the Other damaged and Pressure moving, he falls ill.

zh: 人可信矣，不为夺乎，应克世而被争；
人可用矣，不受非乎，官动官克而被讼；
人可用矣，不有病乎，命墓、应坏、鬼动而患病。
yi: 想要他走，应克世，他就不走；
想要他来，应受阻，他就不来。
这个人可以信任了，会不会被人夺走？应克世，就被人争。
这个人可以用了，会不会遭受是非？官动、官克，就被告。
这个人可以用了，会不会生病？命墓、应坏、鬼动，就患病。
en: If one wants him to go, with the Other controlling the Self he does not go;
if one wants him to come, with the Other obstructed he does not come.
The man can be trusted: will he not be taken from me? With the Other controlling the Self, he is fought over.
The man can be used: will he not meet with slander and trouble? With Pressure moving and Pressure controlling, he is sued.
The man can be used: will he not fall ill? With the life line in the tomb, the Other damaged and Pressure moving, he falls ill.

note.yi: 「去」「来」是问他走不走、来不来。「不为夺乎」是问会不会被别人夺走。「不受非乎」是问会不会遭是非。「官动官克而被讼」是官鬼发动克世，就被告上官府。「命墓」是世爻（命）入墓。「人可信矣」「人可用矣」是三个问法的开头：前一个防被夺，后两个防是非、防病，就是章首目录里的「防夺」「防非」「防病」三问。
note.en: 'Qu' and 'lai' are asking whether he will go or come. 'Bu wei duo hu' asks whether he will be taken away by others. 'Bu shou fei hu' asks whether he will meet with slander and trouble. 'Pressure moving and Pressure controlling, and he is sued' is Pressure moving to control the Self, so that he is taken to court. 'The life line in the tomb' is the Self line (the life) entering the tomb. 'The man can be trusted' and 'the man can be used' open three kinds of question: the first guards against being robbed of him, the other two against slander and against illness, which are the three questions 'guarding against being robbed', 'against slander' and 'against illness' in the index at the head of the chapter.
